verdict.rationale: YPOG publishes a dedicated briefing explaining SAFEs, convertible loan agreements, and ASAs specifically for pre-seed/seed financing (ypog-supp-seedstrapping, ypog-supp-convertibles), plus broader early-stage financing content (venture deals guide, ESOP briefings) and a stated VC ecosystem/transactions practice. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration (e.g., deal league tables, client testimonials) beyond firm-published content, and no dedicated standalone SAFE template/form distinct from the general briefing.
